description: This file defines the class ClaimRequestDecorator, which provides methods to manipulate and access properties of a ClaimRequest object, including setting user, employee, currency, and retrieving expense totals and submission date. It also uses multiple traits for auxiliary services.

classes.name: ClaimRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimRequest providing additional accessors and mutators, integrating services and traits for handling claim requests, expenses, user and employee associations, and formatting dates.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Returns the PayGradeService instance from the container.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User object with the ClaimRequest based on a user ID.

methods.name: setCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the currency type of the ClaimRequest based on a currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyId
methods.description: Retrieves a CurrencyType object based on currency ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with the ClaimRequest based on employee number.

methods.name: getTotalExpense
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total expense for the claim request.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted submitted date of the claim request in Y-m-d format.
